06/ 18.08.2023.

Petitioner above-named who is in custody since 04.12.2022 has moved this Court
for grant of regular bail in connection with Pocso Case No.11 of 2023 arising out of Bariatu P.S.
Case No.306 of 2022 registered under Section 363 of the Indian Penal Code and later on Section
366, 366A, 376(2)(g), 376(D), 114 Ipc and Sections 4, 6, 17 of Pocso Act was added.
Heard the parties.
As per the FIR lodged by father of the victim-girl, his daughter left home to celebrate Deepawali festival in her friend's house on 24.10.2022 and did not return.
She was finally recovered on 27.11.2022 from the house of one Ajay Tirkey.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is not named in the FIR.
Victim has married with one Ajay Tirkey which has come in the statement of girl recorded under Section 164 Cr. P.C. and there is no allegation of rape and kidnapping made against the petitioner.
The petitioner has been implicated on mere suspicion.
Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that the victim is a minor.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the bail application is allowed.

Accordingly, the petitioner named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below and subject to the condition that one of the bailors shall be close relative of the petitioner.
